scope: Live two-stage Arabic wake phrase, five-second command capture, physical ROS control and spoken reply

wake.implementation: VAD-segmented local faster-whisper-base transcription followed by strict phrase matching; not a separately trained keyword model
wake.accepted: Exact phrase or up to three repetitions after spelling normalization

initial_attempts: The existing Vosk Arabic model recognized only مساعد in the wake recording and was not used for the final assistant.
The small model with only مساعد as vocabulary context did not transcribe the wake phrase correctly.
The base model with full wake vocabulary context matched the wake recording and did not treat the existing ON/OFF recordings as wake phrases.
An initial live command did not match the lamp allowlist, so no ROS command was sent.
Initial adaptive calibration could become too high during speech; a lower percentile and a 0.01 ceiling fixed the tested path.
limits: Only controlled wake/ON/OFF examples and a user-reported negative trial were checked; no general wake false-accept or false-reject rate was measured.
The microphone pauses during inference and success replies; this is not full-duplex interaction.
Wake recognition takes a few seconds; command recognition takes about eight seconds after the five-second command window.
No boot-start service, Pi 4 test, weather replies or date replies are included yet.
Debug command recordings stayed private; ambient transcripts and audio were not published.
